rules.label: Build an enchanted item or focus

automation.notes:
Granted: taking the Perk sets up your Sorcerous Power budget (4 points, +2 each level after) and adds the Cost of Sorcery Hang-Up.

Use button "Build a Sorcerous Power": build one from the cost table (Energy damage is the base type; no Power costs less than 1 point); it's added to your sheet, and you're warned if it goes over budget. A trait build puts the Sorcerous trait on the weapon or armor you pick. "Needs a magical focus" links the Power to one of your foci: it can be used only while that focus is in hand.

Use button "Build an enchanted item or focus": spends 2 points (1 for a one-use focus, +1 for a unique adjustment) on a magical focus, built into one of your weapons, armor or gear or an object of its own. A weapon or armor gains the Sorcerous trait. It can grant a basic attack or a Sorcerous Power of up to 3 points, usable once per scene while the focus is in hand. The focus has its own buttons: lost, summoned back for a Story Point, destroyed, and replaced by an hour-long ritual (DIF 15 Performance). A one-use focus is used up the first time.

Left to the table: how long the replacement ritual takes, and special situations where the focus can't be summoned.
